stories.title: Chinese coastguard has 0.3% chance of using weapons in disputed waters, war game suggests
stories.summary: A Chinese coastguard ship is shielding a cluster of fishing boats when several small, fast vessels begin circling – sometimes darting closer, sometimes backing off. Are they just curious fishermen? Or are they probing for a weak spot, trying to lure the patrol ship into a trap? In the real world, a split-second decision could escalate a tense maritime stand-off into something far more dangerous. This is exactly the kind of nerve‑wracking scenario Chinese coastguard researchers have been running...

stories.title: Iran defence chief said Tehran will strengthen defensive capabilities
stories.summary: Iran defence chief said Tehran will strengthen defensive capabilities Iran's acting Defence Minister Majid Ibn Reza said his country will continue to strengthen its defensive capabilities.  Speaking to the IRIB news agency, Reza said Iran remains a "united nation" - dubbing it the most "important part of our defensive power." "Our mission at the Defence Ministry is to build power for Iran, safeguard the security of the nation and develop defensive capabilities that deter the enemy from any miscalculation or designs against his land," said Reza. "We will spare no effort or sacrifice to achieve a strong Iran. We pledge that as long as this mission rests on our shoulders, we will not leave

stories.title: Lukashenko speaks highly of his meeting with Mishustin
stories.summary: The President of Belarus clarified that all problems and issues were discussed together with the Russian Prime Minister
article_sentences: Belarusian President Alexander Lukashenko has stated that his talks with Russian Prime Minister Mikhail Mishustin held the previous day were productive and thorough.
Lukashenko is in Russia on an unofficial visit.

stories.title: Russia, Belarus continue to work actively on international scene — Putin
stories.summary: President mentioned Moscow and Minsk's active work on all international platforms, including the UN, the CIS, and the SCO
article_sentences: Russia and Belarus continue to work actively on the international stage and strengthen the Union State, Russian President Vladimir Putin has said.
"We continue to work actively on the international stage and strengthen the Union State," he stated at a meeting with his Belarusian counterpart Alexander Lukashenko.
Putin noted that the Union State’s Council of Ministers is scheduled to convene soon.
Furthermore, he mentioned Moscow and Minsk's active work on all international platforms, including the UN, the CIS, and the SCO.
"All of this, of course, will also be on our radar today," he added.
